source: Two tools disagree by an order of magnitude and both are on record. Ahrefs keywords-explorer (2026-09-22): best clubs in barcelona 400 US / 2,000 global, clubs in barcelona 600 US / 3,000 global, barcelona nightlife 1,900 US / 5,300 global (the single largest head term across every city checked that day). Google Ads Keyword Planner, same day, owner's account, US, no ad spend so returned as ranges: best clubs in barcelona 1K-10K, clubs in barcelona 1K-10K, barcelona nightlife 100-1K. The numbers below are the Ahrefs global-volume points, kept for the existing keywords/*.json convention; the Keyword Planner ranges are the record of what the other tool showed, not merged into one figure. Full trail in TOPIC-DOSSIERS.md and barcelona-clubs-research.md.
note: Barcelona has the widest open SERP of the three cities checked: several editorial pages in the top 10 for 'best clubs in barcelona' carry 0 referring domains. 'Clubs' collides with cannabis/weed clubs, sex/swinger clubs, padel clubs, wine clubs and social clubs in the matching-terms data, all excluded below. This page's intent is distinct from the site's existing /sonar-festival-barcelona and /primavera-sound-barcelona pages, which target festivals, not year-round clubs.
